senses.gloss: clapping of the hand on the hip.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 5:2:8">Y. Bets. V, 63ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00413"><he>טִיפּוּחַ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 6:9">Kil. VI, 9</cite> <he>תחת הס׳</he> under the place where the rope is attached to the vine.

<cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 1:5">Orl. I, 5</cite> <he>ס׳ הגפנים</he> the connection of grape-vines (by training and engrafting); <he>ס׳ על גבי ס׳</he> engrafting on an engrafted branch; Sifra K’dosh. ch. V, Par. 3 <he>ס׳ על ס׳</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 615:2">Yalk. Lev. 615</cite>.
